title: Stremio Origin
appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Clean subtitles: Quotes, brackets and music notes are gone; only the marks that matter stay. Works with every subtitle, AI-translated ones too.
Your addons' subtitles first: Chosen by themselves from your addons, OpenSubtitles when none has them, and kept in sync quietly in the background.
More skips: Skip intro, recap and credits on far more films, series and anime, from more sources.
Search you can trust: Results are titles on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and the like. Settings › Playback.
